description: Branch E, deciding variants: row-dependent arms of Switch and Choose against IIf, arm-order reversal, and a zero-row filter. Ev has (Id, Denominator, TextValue) = (1,5,'1'), (2,0,'x'), (3,2,'7'). Asks Switch and Choose with a selected arm and an unselected arm 1/[Denominator], IIf with row-dependent arms, two distinct failures (1/[Denominator], CInt([TextValue])) in both arm orders inside Switch, Choose, IIf and a plain sum, each as SELECT Id, expr FROM Ev ORDER BY Id with every Value read attempted, and three of them with WHERE Id = 999 (open, no rows). Follow-up probe (status F) for Branch E, EXPR-STAGE; runs on a read-only open of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
